description: Run bit-exact pure-integer SoftBinary16 proving FP16 stagnation at 2^11 = 2,048 (8,192x worse than FP32) paired with an integer Clements/Reck MZI optical waveguide model (TFLN Pockels drift, Poisson shot noise, ADC ENOB, recurrent mass bleed, chirotope flip, pJ energy) vs. Affine Int128 vQbit (0 drift, 0 floats). Trigger on photonic chips, Q.ANT, TFLN, Mach-Zehnder MZI, optical AI, ENOB noise, FP16 2048 stagnation, or 0x0107_0505.

bias_drift_ppm.description: Thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) Pockels bias drift in ppm (0..25000). [Zero-Float Unit: Int64 ppm]

enob_bits.description: Analog ADC/DAC Effective Number of Bits (4..16). [Zero-Float Unit: Int64 4..16]

photon_budget_per_mac.description: Optical photon count per MAC determining Poisson shot-noise floor (64..10000000). [Zero-Float Unit: Int64 photons]

steps.description: Recurrent accumulation & advection tick depth (1..100000). [Zero-Float Unit: Int64 ticks]

name: affine_audit_photonic_fp16_shear
